Package org.thewhitemage13.handler

Class OrderCreateEventHandler

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.handler.OrderCreateEventHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.thewhitemage13.interfaces.OrderCreateEventHandlerInterface
@Component @KafkaListener(topics="order.created") public class OrderCreateEventHandler extends Object implements org.thewhitemage13.interfaces.OrderCreateEventHandlerInterface
Kafka event handler for handling OrderCreatedEvent messages.

This class listens to the "order.created" Kafka topic and handles the event by creating a new notification indicating that an order has been created. It uses the NotificationService to persist the notification.

Key Features:

  • Listens to the "order.created" Kafka topic.
  • Handles the creation of a notification when an order is created.
  • Interacts with the NotificationService to create and store the notification.
